title: NVDM v1 envelope
description: Identity + provenance wrapper every NVDM artifact carries (docs/specs/nvdm-v1.md Part 5). Object artifacts carry these keys at top level; GeoJSON FeatureCollections carry them as RFC 7946 foreign members.

date.description: ISO 8601 date, year-month, or year, with bounded month/day. Never prose.

kind.description: Closed for validation strictness; APPENDING a kind is a defined one-line MINOR change (spec 4.1), never an architecture debate. Anticipated: village, gram-panchayat, taluk, block, aquifer.

id.description: Registered scope id (spec 4.1). Stable forever; no hierarchy encoded.

projection.description: Present when this artifact is an administrative VIEW of canonical evidence owned by another scope (spec Part 5). Absence asserts the artifact is canonical for its scope.

id.description: Headwaters source-registry id. REQUIRED for living sources (anything that could publish again).

closed.description: Explicit declaration that this upstream will never publish again (a dated letter, a one-time report). Closed sources are exempt from registry membership but MUST carry as_of. as_of alone is NOT a closed-source marker - living sources have evidence dates too.

role.description: Who stands behind the values (spec 5.2). 'asserts' (default): publisher stands behind them, we transport. 'input': raw material for values WE derived (shoreline transects, scores). 'methodology': cited method, not data. role+license is the derivative-encumbrance audit.

license.description: REQUIRED when the artifact redistributes the source's values (spec Part 5).

sources.description: External upstreams only - internal NVDM artifacts consumed as inputs are lineage, described in note, not sources. Non-empty except for self-authored manifests and claim-dataset compilations whose per-record citations carry accountability (validator-enforced: empty requires produced_by-or-claim-contract AND an explanatory note). Per-source accountability: registry id joined via dependsOn (episodic AND continuous upstreams - continuous entries use detection.method 'continuous' and are never polled) OR closed+as_of.

internal_inputs.description: Repo-relative paths of NVDM artifacts this artifact is derived FROM. Machine-readable internal lineage (review 2026-07-30: prose notes do not transfer accountability): the validator caps a derived artifact below L3 while any listed input sits below L2.

conventions.description: Declared traps: sign conventions, aggregation basis, comparability breaks (spec 7.5).

rights_determination.description: An audited, artifact-level judgement that a NAMED restricted input does not encumber THIS file, scored by scripts/nvdm-encumbrance-report.py. It can only lift 'restricted' to 'gov-attribution'; it can never clear nc, share-alike or vague, and can never reach clean-open. It is not a note and not a blanket policy: every field is checked, and a determination that names an input which no longer restricts the artifact is a loud audit error rather than a silent pass.

basis.description: The doctrine relied on. 'derived-facts': the payload is an indicator computed here from measured values, and there is no copyright in facts (Eastern Book Company v D.B. Modak, (2008) 1 SCC 1), so the upstream's terms over ITS OWN document do not reach it. New bases require the classifier to be taught what they may clear.

items.description: A Headwaters source id, or '<repo-relative-path>#inline' for a restricting source that carries no registry id.

clears.description: Exactly which restricted inputs this determination covers. Coverage is a superset test: any restricted contributor reaching this artifact that is NOT named here leaves it restricted. This is what stops a determination from being broader than its own reasoning.

reasoning.description: Why the basis applies TO THIS FILE, naming what the payload actually contains. A generic sentence copied across a directory is the failure this length floor exists to discourage.

dataset.description: <family>/<stem>, must agree with the file path.
